cover: Israel holds critical elections as regional conflict escalates and global tensions rise
cover_scene: A globe illuminated by dramatic spotlighting with polling boxes, air defense missiles, and international assembly flags surrounding it in a dark aesthetic.

slides.scene: A bustling polling station in Jerusalem with voters placing paper ballots into a central blue voting box under bright harsh indoor lights.
slides.headline: Israel holds high-stakes national election
slides.body: Voters across Israel cast ballots in a pivotal national election marked by decades-high early turnout. Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and political rivals face off amid intense internal divisions and ongoing regional security conflicts.

slides.scene: European and NATO flags fluttering in front of a modern glass alliance headquarters in Brussels under a clear blue sky.
slides.headline: European NATO powers commit to increased defence
slides.body: Leaders from major European NATO nations pledged to assume a larger role in continental security while reaffirming their core alliance with the United States. The move comes during widespread debates over transatlantic defense responsibilities.

slides.scene: A wooden gavel resting on a leather-bound law book inside a grand marble federal courthouse hall.
slides.headline: DOJ brings new charges against James Comey
slides.body: The US Department of Justice filed a third set of criminal charges against former FBI Director James Comey. Reports indicate the national defense-related indictment involves alleged disclosures of classified information to the media in 2016.

slides.scene: A desolate, dusty landscape in Sudan with silhouette figures walking past empty food distribution tents under a stark setting sun.
slides.headline: Western powers warn of Sudan famine risk
slides.body: Western nations warned per BBC that millions face acute hunger and famine in Sudan. Ongoing civil war, severe drought, and critical aid funding cuts continue to aggravate the humanitarian crisis across the region.

slides.scene: A vast, glowing data centre corridor filled with server racks glowing with green and blue circuit-board light patterns.
slides.headline: Anthropic files for IPO driving Asian stock gains
slides.body: Asian markets surged following news that artificial intelligence startup Anthropic officially filed for an initial public offering. The public filing tests investor appetite for generative AI after years of soaring private valuations.

slides.scene: A grand, dark auditorium stage illuminated by a single spotlight shining on a golden football trophy atop a pedestal.
slides.headline: Harry Kane wins 2026 Ballon d'Or
slides.body: Bayern Munich and England striker Harry Kane was awarded the men's Ballon d'Or trophy, edging out Kylian Mbappé. Meanwhile, Spanish midfielder Alexia Putellas secured the women's prize at the prestigious ceremony.
